item.title: TotalSpineSeg: Robust Spine Segmentation with Landmark-Based Labeling in MRI
item.dc:creator: Yehuda Warszawer, Nathan Molinier, Jan Valošek, Pierre-Louis Benveniste, Sandrine Bédard, Emanuel Shirbint, Feroze B. Mohamed, Charidimos Tsagkas, Shannon Kolind, Larry Lynd, Jiwon Oh, Alexandre Prat, Roger Tam, Anthony Traboulsee, Scott Patten, Lisa Eunyoung Lee, Anat Achiron, Julien Cohen-Adad
item.category: Preprint; associated conference work is not a journal peer-review record
item.description: Accurate segmentation and labeling of spinal structures are essential for diagnosing and managing spinal pathologies. TotalSpineSeg uses cascaded nnU-Net models and landmark-guided iterative labeling to segment vertebrae, intervertebral discs, spinal cord, and spinal canal across MRI contrasts.

item.title: Mapping brain volume change across time in primary-progressive multiple sclerosis

item.description: Purpose Detection and prediction of the rate of brain volume loss with age is a significant unmet need in patients with primary progressive multiple sclerosis (PPMS).
